create_library_custom_ops: create a Library object to register new PyTorch operators or override existing ones with a custom namespace and dispatch key
define_custom_operator: define a new PyTorch operator with a schema string specifying input and output tensor types
register_operator_impl: register a Python function as the implementation for a custom operator on a specific device dispatch key
register_abstract_impl: register an abstract implementation for a custom operator that defines output shape and type for FakeTensors and meta tensors
get_abstract_impl_context: get the current AbstractImplCtx object inside an abstract impl to construct dynamic output sizes for data-dependent shapes
